incoming.name: Oil refinery
incoming.excerpt: For most of the 20th century, the largest refinery of the world was that of Abadan in Iran.

outgoing.name: 20th century
outgoing.excerpt: It was not until the 20th century that rich oil fields were discovered in the area.

outgoing.name: Abbasid
outgoing.excerpt: Abadan is thought to have originally developed as a port city under the Abbasids' rule.

outgoing.name: Chemistry
outgoing.excerpt: The school specialized in engineering and petroleum chemistry, and was designed to train staff for the refinery in town.

outgoing.name: Oil refinery
outgoing.excerpt: The Anglo-Persian Oil Company built their first pipeline terminus oil refinery in Abadan, starting in 1909 and completing it in 1913.

outgoing.name: Petroleum
outgoing.excerpt: To this day it remains a vast facility for refining petroleum.

outgoing.name: Ptolemy
outgoing.excerpt: Supporting evidence is the name "Apphana" which Ptolemy applies to an island off the mouth of the Tigris.
